what: Cells that fail inside harness input creation (fp8 from_torch into sharded / TILE) are classified xfail_wrong_mode, a loud category the verifier must clear, but the op cannot fix them and the verifier may not edit feature_spec.py. No guidance on how to treat pre-op harness failures.
suggest: verify_supported: split out a harness_input_failure category (exception raised before the op call), or the verifier prompt should state these are reported to the user and do not block shipping.

what: A live tensor memory_config() carries both shard_spec and nd_shard_spec for legacy shards and canonicalizes 2D-expressible ND specs, so shard_api legacy_2d vs nd is not recoverable at runtime. classify_call and the op runtime tagger both check nd_shard_spec first and mis-tag every legacy shard (88 mismatches).
suggest: golden-tests: document that shard_api cannot be split at runtime; either merge legacy_2d/nd into one SUPPORTED decision or have classify_call check memory_layout in HEIGHT/WIDTH/BLOCK before nd_shard_spec.
